_about: Numeric targets for the nocturne 'hyper-real ethereal night' look. Checked by tools/colour/metrics.py report --targets. 'basis' says where each number comes from: R = backed by the research in docs/COLOUR_SCIENCE.md, A = user-approved reference (the original baseline look the user said felt right), P = proposal derived from reasoning, to be confirmed against reference stills.

clip_pct_any_ch_ge250.basis: R: filmic shoulder / tonemapper docs: clipped highlights lose detail

crushed_pct_luma_lt_0.03.basis: P: ethereal wants a lifted floor, but not flat

luma_p1.basis: P: blacks lifted slightly (haze), never exactly 0

luma_p50.basis: A: baseline median 0.24 felt right; rounds B-D at 0.12-0.14 felt too dark

luma_p99.basis: P: highlights reach near white but roll off

split_tone_hue_gap_deg.basis: R: grading guides: add warm/cool separation, a purely monochrome blue frame reads flat

sky_to_floor_luma_ratio.basis: P: sky and lit ground must sit within ~3 stops so neither is sacrificed to exposure

luma.basis: A: baseline sky luma 0.09-0.13 'fit the world'; 0.05-0.07 did not
P: lit marble below the shoulder so veining survives
